title: Jobat.be Jobs Scraper
description: Collect job listings from Jobat.be search pages with enriched job details and clean output.

startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: Jobat.be search URL to start from. Ignored when a keyword is supplied.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Keyword to search for, such as software developer. Takes precedence over the start URL.

results_wanted.title: Results wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of jobs to save.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages
max_pages.description: Maximum number of listing pages to visit.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify residential proxy in Belgium. Jobat.be refuses datacenter IPs, including Apify's cloud IPs, and unpinned residential exits are often blocked, so Belgium residential is the default. Switch to a custom proxy or no proxy only if your own connection is accepted.
